responsibilities: Design, build, and maintain SQL-based data models in the cloud data warehouse to support reporting, self-service analytics, and business analysis.
Translate business requirements into reusable datasets and work with stakeholders to define consistent KPIs across reports and dashboards.
Build and maintain automated data tests and monitoring. Investigate data quality issues, trace them to their source, and coordinate fixes with the teams responsible.
Document data models, metric definitions, and data lineage so users can understand where data comes from and how to use it.
Improve query and transformation performance while managing warehouse compute costs.
Apply software engineering practices to analytics workflows, including version control, code reviews, and automated deployments.

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Build and maintain automated data tests and monitoring
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Rigour signals (automated tests, monitoring, data quality investigation, documentation, lineage) run through the responsibilities with no velocity language, led by "Build and maintain automated data tests and monitoring".
evidence.domain_risk: to support reporting, self-service analytics, and business analysis
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: The posting names no sector or financial or regulatory exposure; the models serve "reporting, self-service analytics, and business analysis", so errors affect business decisions only.
evidence.data_team_maturity: You'll work with data engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: Data engineers and analysts already exist and the role owns an existing "cloud data warehouse" transformation layer, which points to a growing mid-stage function rather than a first hire.
evidence.jd_authorship: Improve query and transformation performance while managing warehouse compute costs.
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Bullets are concrete about the work (tests, lineage, compute costs, code reviews) but name no tools, scale or company context, so they read as part hiring-manager, part generic analytics-engineering template.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The primary audience is data consumers using the modelling layer for "reporting, self-service analytics, and business analysis", with no commercial, product or finance emphasis.
evidence.autonomy_level: You'll own the analytics transformation layer
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role owns a technical domain ("own the analytics transformation layer") while translating business requirements and defining KPIs with stakeholders, which is mixed.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: The posting makes no mention of AI tools or AI data use.
evidence.testing_framing: Build and maintain automated data tests and monitoring
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Testing and monitoring are a responsibility the candidate builds and maintains, not just a listed tool.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Investigate data quality issues, trace them to their source, and coordinate fixes with the teams responsible
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: The fear is operational data-quality failures handled through tests and incident tracing, secondary to delivering models, with no compliance or trust framing.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Design, build, and maintain SQL-based data models
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: Building new models sits alongside maintaining and improving existing ones ("Improve query and transformation performance"), so neither dominates.
evidence.language_gate: Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken.
